description: HAL DMA1 channel 1 memory-to-memory copy of 1 KiB (256 words), verified and timed with DWT->CYCCNT; prints 'm2m ok <cycles>' every 500 ms on USART1
expect: 72 MHz. DMA1 channel 1 MEM2MEM, 32-bit words, both addresses incremented, normal mode, low priority. Right after init and then every 500 ms (deadline based): fill src[256] with a per-round xorshift pattern, clear dst[256] + a guard word, t0 = DWT->CYCCNT, HAL_DMA_Start + HAL_DMA_PollForTransfer(FULL, 10 ms), t1 = DWT->CYCCNT, compare. USART1 PA9/PA10 115200 8N1 prints 'm2m ok <t1 - t0>\r\n' when the copy matches and the guard is intact (else 'm2m FAIL <first bad index>' / 'm2m ERROR <status>'). With the simulator's DMA timing (6 HCLK per SRAM-to-SRAM word: arbitration 2 + read 2 + write 2) the count is 256 x 6 = 1536 cycles plus HAL start / poll overhead, identical every round.

circuit: USART1: virtual terminal on PA9 (TX) / PA10 (RX)
